description: Self-authored (not sourced from any corpus, not written by PlumePdf's own writer) single-page, single-line, 2-glyph document using Courier (a fixed-pitch Standard-14 font, advance width exactly 0.6 * fontSize per glyph, no AFM lookup needed) so glyph origins are exactly hand-computable rather than approximated. Purpose: precisely exercise letter-origin bbox ground truth (D1's 'selected letter bboxes with tolerance') with a fixture where the expected answer is arithmetic, not an oracle-tool estimate.

oracle.method: hand-derived: content stream is `BT /F1 24 Tf 20 50 Td (AB) Tj ET` on Courier; glyph origin X = Td-x + (glyph index * 0.6 * fontSize); glyph origin Y = Td-y (both letters share the baseline, no Tj-internal repositioning).
oracle.notes: tolerancePoints is small (0.75pt) because origin X/Y are exact arithmetic here, not an approximation; letter BBOX HEIGHT (not asserted by this schema's 'origin' fields) is a v1 approximation from font size, which is why this fixture only asserts glyph origin, not a full bounding box.
